Ebbeny: Ebbeny places a high priority on wearing the right clothes and living in the right house that’s in the right suburb. With regard to her occupation, she’ll look for something in the lower echelons of the legal system, a swank accountancy firm or, in a more outgoing specimen, perhaps something in the TV game.
Eboni: The Pick Pocket, which means she aint silly, and she can move quick. (Sister, you ever thought of  getting into theoretical physics?)
Ebony:
Option A:  A professional hockey player whose competitive nature made her lethal, and don’t believe the rumours about her dying young. She’s too energetic and she’s too lucky for that to happen any time soon. 

Option B:  Luckily, however, whenever she passes over to the next adventure she’ll be reincarnated as a Piranha Fish swimming in the Amazon Basin of North Central Brazil. Life’s therefore is a beach for this girl whether she’s alive or not. (And yes, we very much hope she is.)
Echo: Oh baby, movies are only movies. They're not real. Please, if you want to fly don't expect to do it by dreaming big, smiling hard and leaping off a cliff. Go to a flying school and get  your pilot's licence, okay? Lots of love, Management.
Eden: “Is Eden here? Oh, thank god....okay, everybody?...Just relax now. Shake it out. Suck in some deep breaths....everyone feeling good?.....excellent.....so just lie down now, empty your mind and enjoy the moment........Thankyou Eden...”
Edith: Edith has led a long and happy life. Kids, grandkids, travel, turmoil and euphoria - you name it, she’s done it. What a gal.
Edna: Oh Edna, finally a normal name in a world that has gone crazy! I love you. I love your warmth. I love your honesty. I love how you stand up for what you believe in. I love how you deal with adversity and I love your sense of humour. Peace be with you.
Edwina: Edwina is a survivor and a woman of substance.
Effie: Gentlemen, a tip: if you can't hold your end up for longer than the average man with regeards to providing a decent biblical showing of yourself, bascially where and whenever Effie sees fit, be it around the house or at any time in the 24 hour cycle of life, then you are fucking kidding  yourself if you think you're worthy of marrying her. You with me?
Eila: Eila rarely complains and, if she does, something must be rather dire. In life she actually achieves quite a lot. We sound like we’re surprised because we are. Indeed, she’s a well-rounded, sexy, modern woman. Not bad eh?
Eileen: Swears like a trooper, brews her own beer and fishes for Barramundi professionally.
Eilidh: "Ah, stop talkin' shite," she'll say, in a heavy Irish accent.
Eilish:
Eilish is, The Entrusted One.
(ie. she’s the girl at parties who will prevent a drunk person from driving home no matter how much they protest, and she’ll tangle with them physically if she has to.)
Einat: Is she Israeli? If she is it makes sense because Einat is………. The Armourer.
EJ: A cross between Kazza and Daniella. The End.
Elaine: “Will I wear this blouse? Maybe that one? What about this skirt? Will that blouse match this skirt? Or what about that one? Is Arthur going to be there? Hang on, I better try something else….what about this one?”……and so on, and so on.
Elan:
Elan, we up here in the commentary box don't like to give advice but sometimes we think it's warranted. So, yes, now, we recommend you ask your parents if you can borrow the car one night, okay, and when you do that 'borrow' one of their handicards also, and don't come home.
You heard us right. You’re too organised and too nice and you haven’t been, seen or done anything strange or crazy yet. Take a punt girl. Go. The car is insured. And trust us, your parents will eventually sob with pride at the leap you’ve made.
Come and visit us up here in the commentary box. The kettle is on and we’re waiting...
Elayna: No, she's not that technically minded but she grasps the big picture quickly and she knows enough to save your life. Her name is open and replete, with no hidden little ditches to trip over, and it has made her warm and funny and wholly present. She mixes work and pleasure better than nearly anyone, because she perpetually attempts to incorporate one with the other. Nice work hoss.
Eleani: Eleani is just a little bit nuts. Just a tiny bit. The right amount, to be honest. No point being boring, she says that all the time. I don't think she works, only because she cant sit still for very long.
Eleanor: Regal. She's not boring, she just understands a thing called social etiquette. Importantly, she is one of the first people to act when a situation becomes life threatening.
Eleanora: The name of a large, doleful, Grey Nurse shark at an aquarium. She's long and lithe and she seems to move without any effort. And she's doleful only up until the moment she eats or mates.
Electra: Electra is irrefutably more conservative and considerate than you imagine. Yep, she has a ridiculous name, but like a well-made boomerang she’s returned in fine fettle. She’s direct and pleasant, and like everyone she just wants to have fun. (We’ll omit any sexual discussion about Electra, because we can tell you she’s just about sick of it.)
Elektra: Can someone please tell us how Elektra is going to cope in the real world with a name fit for a plastic doll? Elektra, we hope you're not a plastic doll. Have you left home? If you haven't, can you please? We up here in the commentary box have passed around the hat and we've got a little kitty for you to start up with. It's not much but it's a start!
Elena: Elena’s predecessors are European aristocracy that go way back. Hence, her family in the current life expect her to conform to the rather strict rules they lay down as a means to mould her into some kind of modern, polite lady. What horse shit! If they saw what she got up to after she skips out of the house they’d sever all future inheritance. (Elena, we suggest you keep doing what you’re doing.)
Eli: Christmas Eve is actually more fun for her than Christmas itself because it's the day when she and her friends gather for the ritual de-shelling of the prawns. It involves lots of drink, lots of shiny steel bowls for both prawns and shells, rolled up sleeves, some music and perhaps even a quiet little tipple. Eli.
Elia: It's not that Elia is confused or even mildly unintelligent - she's actually quite savvy - but she does seem to be easily rattled. Perhaps she's just a little forgetful, not that we blame her of course. A great many people seem to ask (or suggest) she do a great many things and in these situations it's sometimes difficult to see the wood for the trees, let alone remember you are trying to organise yourself in an at times unphathomable and ridiculous life. She certainly doesn't stay in one place for very long.
Eliana: Rich men and very expensive tastes are what’s on offer here, ladies and gentlemen. We can’t be bothered explaining any more than that.
Elina: Elina takes pride in preening herself to just the right degree. No, her ego doesn't rule her life, but she's a forthright woman who understands that if you don't look the part it's nigh impossible to act the part. She speaks the truth and she doesn't tolerate buffoons. She might be a little kinky though, which is a grand thing, not to mention a wonderful release valve for being in charge all the time.
Eliot: Like her sister with more l’s and t’s, Eliot can't stand to just sit around and watch, and she especially can’t stand to watch someone fuck things up. It literally drives her insane. At formal presentations she’s the one cracking jokes at the back and grappling colleagues inappropriately beneath the table. God bless you Eliot.
Elisa: Never overbearing or a bully, Elisa likes playing and we’re glad to see her name on the team sheet. Not really inclined to get in and get really dirty, Elisa is more or a periphery player who looks fabulous running with the ball in her hand. She doesn’t like to see anyone hurt. Indeed, she’ll often attend an opposition player if they are injured, which often infuriates her team mates.
Elisabeth:
"A pinch and punch for the first of the month!" she says gaily, while you rub your arm at the amount of pain she's just inflicted. 
What are you going to do, NOT live with her?
Elise: Shy like grass, maybe. Chances are she grew out of that, however, and slid into the business world as easily as an otter yawns on the water’s edge before slipping back beneath the surface. Is she open to bribery? Well, not if it involves ripping off people who don’t deserve it. Usually Elise is pretty cute, which, in this absurd, male-driven business environment helps her achieve most of her goals reasonably easily. She knows she doesn’t live in Iraq or Afghanistan where women are perpetually persecuted, and so she doesn’t mind taking a few liberties when she can. She knows she’s just lucky that she can.
Elisha: Elisha, if you don’t put away your phone and start concentrating here in class we're going to confiscate it. As a burgeoning adult she goes through men like cheap frozen dinners.
Elissa: Elissa is quite beautiful and she knows how to keep a secret.
Eliza: Excuse my French, but Eliza is simply fucking delightful. She's another Good Witch, you understand. Did you know that?
Eliza-Jane:
Eliza-Jane has a very detailed list and woe-betide anyone if they suggest a few things on it should be forgotten or skipped. She still believes in the magic of lingerie and she attracts men who think along similar lines. They’re usually not permitted to nibble her through them however, only because her collection is as rare as it is expensive. 
(Note: The more evolved Eliza-Janes are called EJ, and this sub-species has long-learned the fun in having all manner of clothes nibbled off her own body, and she couldn’t give a flying fuck if a few trivial points on the agenda are skipped, either. Amen.)
Elizabeth: Elizabeth, if she is called this and knows no other nickname, owns an opulent dining room full of fine china and heavy silver cutlery. Her grand house has an Aston Martin parked out the front, and she has had a crush on the right side of Julio Iglesias’s head since she was a little girl.
Elka: A cross between a cute little Eskimo man wearing deer fur and Bambi, the baby deer, Elka exists as the perfect circle of life. Sexy as hell with a clean view of the world, and of herself, Elka milks the moments for their worth with the luxury of someone who embodies the big picture as well.
Elke: Serious, serious, serious, serious, serious….(then)...okay, hug now please!!
Ella:
Ella rhymes with, “Yeah...whaddaya want?” 
And it takes a lot of energy for her just to say it, let alone act on the answer, which she will only if she thinks she needs to. Don’t waste her time with trivial tasks.
Ellay-rose: Surrounded by chaos, sometimes in her house, sometimes in her street, Ellay-Rose has learnt to ride with the punches and go with the flow. Yes, humans can be unpredictable beasts at the best of times, but this rather energetic beginning has prepared her for a life that is anything but boring. Grace under pressure: this sums her up quite nicely. Sure, she'll crash her share of cars and hang out with the wrong boys for a while, but she knows what she's doing.
Elle: “Oh yeah, I don’t care.” she shrugs, nonchalantly, barely half awake. “That sounds fine. Can someone make me a coffee before we leave, thanks....”
Elle-Louise: An A-type personality in and out of the bedroom, and don’t get me started on how she reacts to misspellings of her name. In fact, that’s enough. I’m tired of her complaining about it. Suffice to say she could run a country quite well and we’ll just leave it at that.
Ellen: Yes, true, in a past life her name was, indeed, Alan, which is why she shrugs off all problems, in this life, with a look on her face as if to say, "Listen, dickhead, what the fuck are you complaining about? If you've got you're health, you've got everything." And, Amen to that.
Ellia:
Ellia is a fun-loving, life-kicking kind of a lass, who is great fun to have around, and who is incisive in her observations. Like a male Jasper, she's good at getting around corners and finding the weak spots. Not that she's here to deliberately screw things up - she's never that malicious - she just likes to encourage others to be the best they can be, and sometimes a quiet word in someone's ear is enough. She'd only publicly embarrass someone if they deserved it. 

Note: If you give Ellia the reigns, the helm, or the map, and you tell her to drive for a while, don't expect her to relinquish control in a hurry.
Elliana: Standing stark-naked in the middle of the street for some kind of weird European magazine is not where you will ever see Elliana. You're more likely to find her sipping demurely at her latte in downtown whereever, preparing for a conservative day of work/house chores. (Nice house though.)
Ellie: The sensual female monk. Not much really seems to faze her because she believes that everything in the world is linked, and that all things are part of an ever-changing system of energetic flux. In a nutshell, she is optimistic, young at heart, and she knows that good things come and good things go.
Ellinja: No, she doesn't really adhere to a stock-standard path, be it in the wilderness or down the career road. Her name is completely open-ended at the finish, and in many respects the world is her oyster. But she needs to look up, or maybe she needs prompting to look up. It's a big, crazy and wonderful world out there and Ellinja is best advised to travel plenty - certainly, her best work will be done thousands of miles from where she was born. What that is exactly, however, is anyone's guess!
Elliott: Geez, where do you start with Elliott? In a nutshell, she's a delightful, unpredictable and happy little chicken who darts about sprucing things up and breathing fresh air into old houses and washed-up personalities who haven't seen light for years. She's make great medical doctor but Elliott needs fresh air, herself, and hospitals just don't cut it.
Ellise: If she's not extremely timid in the face of a microphone, then Ellise is whip-smart and lightning quick, and she ain't slowed down by micophones, bulls or out of control aircraft. There are two very disparate outcomes here so who have you got?
Ellodie: How and why is it that some people seem to attract confessions? Ellodie has this skill. She doesn't even mean to do it, which means her energy or her aura is subconsciously recognized by people around her as being loving, intelligent, wise and objective. She should probably start charging.
Ellouise:
What I’d give to get all the ‘Ellouise-type-spelling’ ladies together and just watch them talk.Very soon they’d realise they’re all very bloody similar. i.e: Spunks. Loud. Power players. Always right. Funny on their day. Impatient….etc etc etc. 

So, good evening & good luck.
Elly: Just like her twin sister, Elly is a sensual female monk. Not much really seems to faze her because she believes that everything in the world is linked, and that all things are part of an ever-changing system of energetic flux. In a nutshell, she is optimistic, young at heart, and she knows that good things come and good things go.
Elly-May: If she hides something then give up trying to find it because there's no way. She was highly prized by Jewish families during World War 2 when trying to find hiding places from the SS guards. Not only that, if she needs to talk she'll talk but equally she understands the power of silence.
Ellyn: Ellyn is the kind of girl who, if attending a rodeo, will literally have to stop herself from leaping over the fence and running out into the stadium to go and help the clowns, who are currently attempting to distract a 500kg bull from stomping a cowboy to death. She loves this kind of thing. Similarly, a couple of years back she went to South Africa to dive with the sharks. While most of the men on board just wanted to flirt with her, all she wanted to do was launch over the side to see if it was possible to be towed along by a 6m great white if she grabbed its dorsal fin. Bored - Ellyn is never that for very long. Know what I mean?
Elodie: Elodie will blow the whistle, she will yell the truth, she will be in the face of liars, cheats, con artists and charlatans. Thank God humans are evolving because Elodie has copped it hard in previous lifetimes. She's been burned at the stake, drowned, fed to rats - you name it - all because she saw past all the ridiculous bullshit mythology that her uneducated world of yester-year was brainwashed with and refused to keep quiet. You know what we need? Elodie as Prime Minister or President, then we'd see some real, meaningful change. (Note: Elodie, we'll help with your campaign. Management. x)
Eloise: The spunkrat who doesn't even know it. Eloise is the kind of girl every man hits on at the Christmas party.
Elsa:
Look out ladies and gentlemen. Here we have on our hands another heart-breaker. As we're pretty sure we've said before, you can't explain it, you can't grow it and you certainly can't put it in a bottle. It just is. You're just born with it, we think. We're still figuring out the mechanism. Anyway, Elsa is the girl all the girls want to be, and all the boys want to marry whether they're into marrying or not. Indeed, most of the girls want to marry her too, even if they're not into girls. It's just how she is.

Thanks Els', we'll leave you to it, and bravo.

(Oh yeah, Elsa is sensual, caring, spontaneous, happy, wise, present, smells amazing, great listener, and best of all she's lucky. The end.)
Elsbeth: It's a miracle she's alive. For example, the last time she went to Africa a humble spider fell in her lap while she was driving somewhere. Calmly (bullshit), she let go of the steering wheel screaming, to whit the car veered off the road, crashed through a barrier and plunged into a river. With the help of some local kids who were swimming nearby, she made it back to shore and eventually back to their village where she was given dry clothes and food. Later that night she wound up dancing around the fire in traditional clobber, and rumour has it the chief proposed to her. But you should have seen what happened to her when she tried SCUBA diving. Anyway, someone needs to make a TV show about her. The end.
Elsie: Elsie almost never encounters freaks or arse holes, she wears flowers in her hair and likes to make love in the hay, at least she did when she was younger. Is she a little bit shy? Not usually, but she’d rather keep her mouth shut if there’s a dickhead in the room, put it that way.
Elspeth: The drought on the property lasted years and finally, just last night, it broke. How'd you celebrate? You stripped naked, walked out into the magnificent deluge and pointed your face and hands to heavens, before yelling out, "…Oh Elspeth! GLORY BE, MY ANGEL!"
Elvie: Elvie is a rip-snorter. She’ll trek on her own if she needs to, she’ll passionately kiss in public for the same reasons and she’s been caught shagging more than once. Dramas for her barely register because she is here to live well, which means things like regrets don’t exist either. Everyone is happy when she shows up, be it for work or play. Oh yeah, and she’s more reliable than she sounds.
Elvira: A drop-dead raven-haired fire-ball who is deliciously naughty and/or artistically magnificent. Hopefully a bit of both.
Em: An affable, funny and sexy doer who means well and does well.
Emalee: "Emalee! Wait your turn, please!"……if she's heard it once she's heard it a thousand times.
Emalina:
Accident-prone. Nice girl, sure, but be careful lending her your car (never a motorbike) and how many sets of keys has she managed to accidentally drop into storm-water drains? 
Plenty.
Emelia: A very shiny, full gas bottle. She is therefore as powerful as she is dangerous.
Emely: If her boyfriend is so much as 30seconds late picking her up, LOOK OUT!!
Emerald: A little confused about what to do in the world, Emerald bumps along for the most part. Even she admits that the profitable situation she is standing in happened largely as a fluke. The universe will never forget about her because she has a good heart and a kind soul, so imagine what she could achieve if she stood up proudly, confidently, and stepped to where she knew she needed to be with real gusto? It’d be quite something, we assure you…
Emerson: A busy, cute and very capable tomboy.
Emi-lee: True, her resting pulse is about 100 bpm but this is perfectly healthy for her. Like a fast-twitch muscle ever-ready to take on the world and to leap into action, Emi-lee never dies wondering. Rash, she may be, but she always seems to get the job done. Like Annie way before her, she is never where you think she is.
Emile: Wow, what a sexy, fun-loving cat she is! Very smart, Emile knows what she wants, knows how she's going to get there and all we can hope for is that she asks us to come along.
Emilia: Like a chilled carafe of well-made sangria sitting quietly on a white marble bar at 11pm, to suggest that Emilia is either underprepared or unwilling to get the job done is pure folly. And, oh yes, she's here to have fun but just be mindful that there is a certain etiquette with regards to drinking a well-made sangria, especially here in Portugal. Good luck!
Emilie: The Delegator, The Organiser, The No-Shit-Taker, The Revenge Seeker (if she thinks the person will benefit), The Taster-Not-The-Cook, The Champagne Popper, The Never-Does-The-Dishes, and lastly, the girl who can get by on 3 hours sleep. Yep, she's full-on kids.
Emily:
Yes, it’s true, Emily was once crowned the Table Manners World Champion. She won it in Zurich apparently, ages ago. How did she accomplish this feat, you ask? Well, it was easy really. For a start Emily is highly competitive - did you know that? - she has impeccably high standards when it comes to public behaviour (which couples nicely with her capacity to find faults in systems/personalities) and her middle-class background (minimum) means she knows a decent restaurant menu when she sees one.
And just a little note to any fellow who aspires to court our Emily: If you get so far as being involved with her you need to get comfortable with the notion that she’ll be wearing the pants in the relationship, not you.
So, you got all that?
Emilyn-Maie: If she'd been a rugby league or gridiron player she'd have been feared and revered across the league for the ferocity of her attack on both the opposition players and the ball. Sure, she's pissed off that she has to spell her name 12 times per week but hey-ho, life could be worse. She's no fool, and she knows what she wants.
Emma: Like the surface of a swollen river after the monsoon, she’s smooth and bubbling on the surface, but all those m’s are almost too perfect to be true because beneath them is a chaotic riverbed of drama and complexity. Befriend one and you must ask yourself the question: Can I swim?
Emma-Kate:
Like a traffic cop who is going to fine you, no matter how much you complain and beg and plead and offer-up genuine, legitimate excuses for why she pulled you over in the first place, she will smile, and nod, and placate where necessary, but when the rules (be they official or otherwise) are broken you can expect to pay the penalty.
Stand up straight, be proud of what you are and take responsibility for your actions: this is EK's mantra.
Emma-Leigh: Sure, she drives fast and furiously, but she hasn't crashed yet and (touch wood) we don't expect her to. In that regard feel free to give her the keys to the captaincy of the team as well. Once she makes a decision she sticks to it and she'll harass anyone who initially said they were on board but for whatever reason has lost enthusiasm. Emma-Leigh hasn't got time to fuss about with lazy, lying shit heads. Her only impatience stems from having to apply this thing called makeup. Want our advice EL? Toss it all out. You don’t need it.
Emmalyn:
Emmalyn’s disquiet here in the 21st Century stems from being burnt at the stake once upon a time just for being a strong and independent woman. The idiots considered her a witch, when all she was doing was standing up for her sisters and encouraging a little free-thinking among them. What the hell is wrong with that? (Please read that line again, all you dim-witted, narrow-minded fundamental religious men.)

So, give her a little latitude. Emmalyn is on a mission and if she succeeds then we all win. End of story.
Emmelene: Martyrdom - forget it. She's not that political. And anyway, she'd get her finger nails dirty.
Emmeline: A very French version of Stephanie!
Emmylou: Emmylou is an idiot at heart who embraces all debauched behaviour and she loves the sound of her own shrill attempts at opera singing which, sadly, are truly crap.
Enfys: Enfys is the name given to the first rock that a shipwreck survivor (Michelle, or Angela, perhaps?) first grabs a-hold of when they miraculously reach the shore. Yes, she will cut and graze you, but how much do you need her?
Enid: Enid is the name of any grandmother that interrupts a game of backyard cricket or baseball with a tray of biscuits and raspberry cordial, although she always did like beautiful young boys.
Erica: Illogical. Neurotic. Schizophrenic. Although, perhaps it’s not all her fault because Erica is occasionally infected by mean-spirited ghosts that make her behave very erratically, sometimes dangerously.
Erika: Does a more competent, single-minded woman exist? If she joined the airforce she'd waltz through the jet fighter course to the point where her fellow (male) students wouldn't even question her capacity to pass the course and end up on a squadron somewhere. (As ever, you don't really want to mess with her, even if she's on the ground.)
Erin: Erin is relaxed, sensual, playful and, despite her occasionally serious look, she rarely loses her sense of humour. She keeps fit, physically and spiritually, and she does it all amid a whirlwind of friends and socialness because she lives her life for her and not for anyone else.
Erolyn: Erolyn is one of those people always running late. She's never on time to catch a plane, for example, which is a pity because she catches heaps.
Eske: She’s Dutch, and so she knows what an esky is, already. That is, a venue for fun and friends. And so she is.
Esmai: Esmai is an army general who is adored by the troops, and whose arrival into camp always provides a wonderful boost for morale. She looks each soldier in the eye and listens intently to what they say. Whether she’s taking-in all she hears is irrelevant because each man and woman knows she has their welfare in mind as much as she can, even though they know war is hell, and that not everyone will be alive this time tomorrow night. She’s here right now, and that's whats important. Esmai.
Esme: Nah, forget the hype. Esme is lovely, downright lovely. Indeed, everyone, stand to attention and salute. Thankyou. Thankyou Esme.
Essena: Rarely outlandish, Essena is a quietly-spoken girl who looks like she’s thinking heavily most of the time. Not often the leader the of the pack, she kind of glides along on the third or fourth rung in any hierarchy but she always attracts plenty of attention from the boys.
Esta: A roaring gale can't keep this girl down - no way. Esta can run, stop and pivot faster than anyone. She changes jobs every two or three weeks, her boyfriends and lovers even more often and in the end, people go to her house with a pre-written message for her, knowing that she's not going to be home even when she says she is. Esta needs a crash helmet.
Estelle: This girl has a smile that’s wider than the horizon and a laugh that can be heard for miles, and the ghosts of her ancestors tread the landscape, still.
Ester: Having spent all day building a 20 foot-high bonfire, if you don’t let her light it then there’ll be hell to pay!
Esther: If Esther isn’t in a nursing home, then she is young, incredibly intelligent, wears comfortable shoes and cackles loudly. Like a few others in the Kingdom, however, the energy she generates also gives her the capacity to attract weirdos by the 100’s.
Ethel: Good old fashion shoe polish. Big in the 50’s.
Etsuko: The frisky Japanese princess who detests the royal life. She'd much rather go to a concert and sneak her way into the mosh pit, up the front, than attend the cocktail party at another foreign embassy. Her father isn't happy, but that's nothing new.
Eunice: A cross between Janice and a lump of wood, as a very expensive life-like doll made in Japan for extremely lonely men, Eunice looks incredible but there is some question as to whether or not she is plugged in. Anyone got a double adaptor?
Eustacia: For god's sake, can someone pull her away from that bloody laboratory for a while and stick a drink in her hand. Oh, she doesn't drink? Okay, well that's fine, give her some cake. Or maybe a can of coke. What? She doesn't eat sugar? Okay, get a few of you, bust into the research station lab, pick her up and take her down to the beach, clothes and all, and then throw her in the ocean. Life doesn’t have to be all work and no play, girl.
Ev: Ev is everyone’s great mate because everyone feels comfortable around her. (Unless, of course, you happen to be one of the few people that she detests, and you would need to be a complete prick/bitch to achieve that.)
Eva: Powerful and sexy when she needs to be, Eva is forgiving, compassionate and deliciously unselfconscious, everywhere else. She laughs with her whole body and it affects all those within earshot. There was never any doubt; Eva is an incredible woman.
Evalena: Evalena has guts and she has nous. She'll travel and laugh, and squeeze the juice out of every situation. She says yes most of the time and doesn't stand for idiocy for more than about 9 seconds. Big smile. Big heart. Unapologetic.
Evander: Crikey, you'd think it wasn't a difficult task, would you. All you asked of her was to take the car down to the mechanic and drop it off for a simple service. The car's in good shape anyway, really, but she's been watching a little too much of Pimp My Ride, hasn't she. So, what was going to be a normal $200 change-of-oil and a general check-up has turned into a 5 grand fiasco involving a stereo that kind of everts itself out of the entire back seat, not to mention these ridiculous white-wall tyres that alone cost $800 a pop. God, what next?
Evangelina: The name of a seldom-heard-of play by William Shakespeare. Basically, it’s a story of a beautiful young peasant girl, the young man who loves her and the effect she has on the King (and monarchy) after a chance encounter by the main castle gates, one day. In short, it’s an explosive tale of love, ambition and betrayal that will remain with you long after you leave the theatre. In summation, if you were married to Evangelina life would never be dull.
Eve:
Option A:  Eve doesn’t have a nasty bone in her body. She’s very disappointed when her trust is misplaced and, after events such as this, it take ages for her to recover. 

Option B:  She is Leecey’s major support up there in the forest. Yes, Eve has been known to cut the throat of a living goat with a knife but it’s all for a good cause. Thank God we’ve started to celebrate some of our witches!
Evelina: The pre-eminent goddess who walks amongst us, and who deals with the young and old in the same fashion. Like a few other girls in the Kingdom she tends to stop most rooms she walks into and the only hiccup arises when her father, husband, boyfriend, girlfriend, mother or housemate won't let her drive because of how much champagne she's drunk.
Evie: Evie's heart is in the middle of her body and at the centre of her life. She'd never work for the military, for example, and if she did it'd only be as a Colonel in charge of a humanitarian aid effort after some natural disaster or other. Evie has a large number of wonderful friends but it's not all Bible studies and biscuits. If you're a bit glum and want to party, Evie can do that too, because this girl is able to devote herself to a cause. She's here to help, don't forget.
Evizel:
Evizel is complicated – you might as well try and explain why an Australian Echidna tries, unsuccessfully, to dig its way into a pile of gravel – but the important thing to remember is that Evizel rhymes with 
Everythingsgonnabealrightintheend. And it is.
Evy: What a woman? She’s cares about you and the world, she listens, she gives good advice and she laughs all the time. In fact, where is she when you need her?
Ezi: Serene and unflappable, Ezi is a quick learner and therefore super-skilled at everything she tries. Smart arse subtlety from male idiots is none of her business, thankfully. Ezi is bloody delightful.
